# Product Requirements Document (PRD)

---

# 1. Executive Summary

Provide a concise overview of the proposed solution.

Include:

- Business Problem
- Proposed Solution
- Expected Business Value
- Success Criteria

---

# 2. Business Problem

Describe:

- Current challenges
- Existing pain points
- Why the project is needed

---

# 3. Business Vision

Describe the desired future state.

---

# 4. Business Objectives

List measurable business objectives.

| ID | Objective | Success Metric |

---

# 5. Stakeholders

| Role | Responsibility |

---

# 6. Target Users

Describe intended users.

Include:

- Primary Users
- Secondary Users

---

# 7. User Personas

For each persona include:

- Name
- Role
- Goals
- Pain Points

---

# 8. Scope

## In Scope

List all functionality included.

## Out of Scope

Clearly identify exclusions.

---

# 9. Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Business Value |

Use MoSCoW Prioritization.

---

# 10. Non-functional Requirements

| Category | Requirement |

Include:

- Performance
- Scalability
- Security
- Availability
- Reliability
- Accessibility
- Compliance
- Maintainability

---

# 11. Business Rules

Document all applicable business rules.

---

# 12. Assumptions

Document all assumptions.

---

# 13. Constraints

Include:

- Technical
- Business
- Budget
- Timeline

---

# 14. Dependencies

Include:

- Internal
- External
- Third-party

---

# 15. Risks

| Risk | Impact | Probability | Mitigation |

---

# 16. User Journey

Describe the end-to-end user journey.

---

# 17. Use Cases

For every major capability include:

- Actor
- Trigger
- Preconditions
- Flow
- Exceptions
- Expected Result

---

# 18. Epics

| Epic ID | Epic | Business Goal |

---

# 19. Features

| Feature ID | Epic | Feature | Priority |

---

# 20. User Stories

Use the format:

As a <Role>

I want <Capability>

So that <Business Value>

Include:

- Story ID
- Priority
- Story Points
- Dependencies

---

# 21. Acceptance Criteria

Use Given / When / Then format.

---

# 22. MVP Scope

Identify features included in the first release.

---

# 23. Release Plan

Include:

- MVP
- Phase 2
- Phase 3

---

# 24. Milestones

| Milestone | Target |

---

# 25. Success Metrics (KPIs)

List measurable KPIs.

---

# 26. Future Enhancements

List future improvements.

---

# 27. Glossary

Define business terminology.

---

# 28. Appendix

Additional references and supporting information.
